annotations.title: SAM.gov Opportunities Search: US Federal Contract Notices

description: Search US federal contract opportunities and awards from the public SAM.gov daily extract: solicitations, award notices and other notice types with agency, office, NAICS and PSC codes, set-aside, response deadline, place of performance, award number, amount and awardee company, and the notice link. Newest first, no API key and no daily request limit. Contact persons, e-mail addresses, phone numbers and free-text descriptions are not returned. Read-only: returns data, nothing is changed or sent. Free over MCP (30 requests a minute).

activeOnly.description: Only notices that are still active (default). Set false to include archived notices and awards.

keyword.description: Words that must appear in the title.

limit.description: Maximum notices returned, newest first. Each returned notice is one billable result.

naics.description: NAICS codes or prefixes (for example 5415 for computer systems design).

psc.description: Product and service codes or prefixes (for example D3 or R4).

setAside.description: Set-aside codes (for example SBA, 8A, HZC, SDVOSBC, WOSB).

since.description: Only notices posted on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: 7 days ago. Use the date of your last run for new notices only.

states.description: Place-of-performance state codes (for example VA, TX).

types.description: Notice types (for example Solicitation, Combined Synopsis/Solicitation, Award Notice, Sources Sought, Special Notice, Presolicitation).

until.description: Only notices posted on or before this date.
